title: Luna CCTV & Spatial Security System V1
status: REFERENCE / CONCEPTUAL / SIMULATED — no live video, PTZ or recording exists in this reference build
newCanonicalAssetsJustification: none created — the Master Equipment Schedule's own Current instance register already documents every camera this phase needed; no NVR/recording asset exists (EQ-RECORDING: 'No registered instance yet') and none was fabricated

liveVideoAbstraction.evidence: lunaRuntimeSeed.ts's own pre-existing comment: camera streams have 'no non-fake way to represent' — stream.start/stream.stop/door_release deliberately unmapped
liveVideoAbstraction.consequence: no LIVE_VIEW capability exposed anywhere; camera context is state-only reference, never a fabricated stream

cameraStateModel.excludedStatesReason: no fault/maintenance field exists on any camera's runtime row and no scenario sets one — nothing in the canonical catalog legitimately models these stages for cameras
cameraStateModel.existingReusedScenario: camera-offline (lunaScenarios.ts) — pre-existing, reused as-is, not recreated
cameraStateModel.recovery: i.resetAll() — matches the exact recovery convention every other system's own tests already use

cameraCapabilities.reason: Master Equipment Schedule's own 'observable; none' — zero commands were fabricated for any of the four cameras

equipment: CameraGeometry — wall/ceiling bullet camera body, mounting bracket, forward-facing lens, status LED whose color follows the camera's own real online/offline state
physicalGeometry.fieldOfViewCone: deliberately omitted — the brief's own instruction that such a cone must never determine authorization/event truth made it simpler and more honest to skip a purely decorative element for V1
physicalGeometry.dispatch: CCTV_EQUIPMENT_REFS (built from lunaCameraResolver.ts's own CCTV_CAMERA_REFS) in OperationalAssetLayer.tsx, same by-ref dispatch pattern as every prior system's equipment

accessEventCorrelation.relationshipType: monitored_by (pre-existing EngineeringRelationshipType — no new type was added)

edges.basis: identical locationLabel ('Level 06, Apartment A — Entry'), <1m apart; the intercom is already kind:'camera' in the canonical schedule

deliberatelyUnresolved.reason: different locationLabel/position (~3m) than the Parking camera — not guessed
no camera at a matching locationLabel/position — not inferred from proximity

accessEventCorrelation.resolver: resolveCameraForAccessPoint(accessPointRef) in lunaCameraResolver.ts — walks the real edge only, never proximity

controlBoard.summaryWidget: CctvStatusSummary — reused headerContent? slot, dom hooks [data-cctv-status-summary]
controlBoard.accessCorrelationSection: AccessCorrelationSummary — shown only when the focused camera has a real monitored_by relationship, reads resolveAccessState()/getAccessEvents() directly
controlBoard.privateIntercomExcluded: the apartment video intercom is deliberately NOT a board tab — HIDDEN to Facility, same disclosed boundary as HVAC's indoor units / Access's own lock

oyiIntelligence.newMatcher: matchCctvInvestigation in lunaIntentParser.ts, inserted after matchAccessStatus
newVocabulary: camera 01 / camera 1 ... camera 04 / camera 4 added to each existing camera's own alias list
LUNA-L06-APT-A-ENTRY-INTERCOM-01's first-ever aliases (the camera at apartment 6a, apartment 6a camera, the intercom, video intercom, the doorbell)
oyiIntelligence.collisionCheck: every new pattern checked against the full existing FACILITY_ASSET_ALIASES list and every other system's own target-phrase list — re-verified in scripts/verifyCctv.mjs (Electrical's 'active power path', HVAC's 'turn on the AC', Access's 'is the main entrance locked', Water's 'the water tank' all re-tested unaffected)
targetPhrasesVerified: Show me the camera at Apartment 6A.
Show me the last access event.
Show me the camera associated with the last denied access.
oyiIntelligence.parserPurity: matchCctvInvestigation never reads live runtime/event state itself — it only resolves TEXT to a REF (the one real camera correlated to the one governed access point); the live event/camera narrative is composed later by lunaExplain.ts, the same purity every other matcher preserves

commonCameras.note: a resident does NOT gain Facility CCTV visibility merely because a camera exists in common space — pre-existing rule, re-verified not broken

privateIntercom.note: same pre-existing private-unit rule as the entrance lock — the camera never becomes an authorization authority, and privacy holds even for security investigation (proven via full controller round-trip: resident investigation succeeds end-to-end, identical Facility request denied end-to-end)

accessCctvBoundary.verifiedVia: scripts/verifyCctv.mjs check 6 — a camera going offline never writes to the Access event log

safetyBoundaries: no PTZ, recording, playback, live-view or event-search capability was fabricated for any camera
no FAULT/MAINTENANCE camera state was fabricated — no runtime field or scenario supports them
camera-to-access-point relationships are real canonical edges, never inferred from proximity — two unresolved pairs were explicitly left without an edge
no field-of-view cone geometry was added, to avoid any risk of a purely visual element being read as operational/authorization truth
no security certification, facial-recognition, or surveillance-analytics claim was made anywhere

tests.browser: scripts/verifyCctvBrowser.mjs — 5 journeys, 5 screenshots, full Elevator/Water/Electrical/Fire/HVAC/Access regression included
